label: Lower after a rewarded trial; higher at S2 and when belief favours S2.
terms: prev_reward == 1 ;; (tv("reward", -2) == 1) + (tv("reward", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) ;; (phase != D1) * belief_lo ;; (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == prev_state) * (prev_reward==1) ;; (phase==D2)*(state==prev_state) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2)*(prev_reward==0)
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 45, dominated by a timing decline over the episode (timing R^2 0.91). Beyond timing, the main driver is the last reward: z drops about 0.06 at all phases of the trial after a rewarded trial and stays high after an unrewarded one. On top of that it is higher at D2 when S2 is reached, and at GO/D2 it is higher the more the ideal observer believes S2 is good (negative belief_lo). The free fit adds a small further drop for rewards two and three trials back (consecutive rewards push it lower), a boost after unrewarded S1 trials, and D2 terms for reaching the same state as last trial, raising test R^2 from 0.43 to 0.47 (short form is 92% of free fit). No future variables used.

issues: Every term carries real weight on the test split. The full short form scores 0.4305. Dropping the D2 S2 term gives 0.375, dropping the belief term gives 0.326, and prev_reward alone gives 0.233. Fitted weights: prev_reward -0.063, D2*S2 +0.040, belief_lo -0.009 (so higher when belief favours S2). The label's signs match.

The label leaves out that the belief effect is absent at D1. Letting belief act at every phase lowers the test score to 0.392, and the D1 belief-decile residuals are non-monotone. The label should say 'at GO and D2'.

The explanation says the reward drop holds 'on every phase'. At D2 the residual table is mixed (D2 after a2 S2 r +0.024, after a1 S2 u -0.041). Even so, limiting the reward term to D1 and GO drops the test score to 0.30, so the reward term is needed at D2 as well.
The claim that 'runs of rewards push z lower' does not hold up in a short form. Adding rewards two and three trials back into the reward term lowers the test score to 0.321 and 0.288.

Slightly better variant: (phase == D2)*(state == 2)*prev_reward scores test 0.4424, so the S2 boost at D2 mostly comes after rewarded trials. The gain is small and makes the label more awkward, so it is not adopted.

Remaining systematic misses (dev): after an unrewarded S1 trial the short form under-predicts z by about 0.03 at D1 and GO; at D2 after a1 S2 u it over-predicts by -0.054. These come from last-trial evidence that belief_lo only partly captures. They are moderate relative to the free-fit gap (0.43 vs 0.47) and the observed-only ceiling (0.53).

The largest single-window misses come late in the episode (trials 85-91) after reward runs, with errors of about 0.2. The timing baseline falls steeply inside decile 8 there, so these look like drift within the decile rather than a missing cue. Scaling the terms by ep_dec or ep_trial did not help (0.33-0.43).
skeptic.revised_label: Lower after a rewarded trial; higher at D2 on reaching S2, and at GO/D2 when belief favours S2.

final_label: Lower after a rewarded trial; higher at D2 on reaching S2, and at GO/D2 when belief favours S2.
